changes.title: Lindsey Graham Dies at 71: A Look Back at His Influential Career
changes.summary: Lindsey Graham, an Air Force veteran from South Carolina and one of the most influential senators in American foreign policy, has died at 71. Graham had just returned from a lengthy trip to Ukraine and Ankara, Turkey. NBC’s Julie Tsirkin reports for Sunday TODAY.

changes.title: Trump Sought an Iran War Exit. Putin Pushed On in Ukraine. Now Both Are Stuck.
changes.summary: The Iran and Ukraine wars underline the common limits of military force in achieving political ends, but also the differences between a dug-in Russian president and a vacillating American one.
